evals.prompt: QA the site before release — desktop, mobile and the projector.
evals.expected_output: Runs visual-qa.mjs at all widths with checks + reduced motion, 1280x720 at 125 %, inspects PNGs, writes QA.md with PASS/FAIL verdict.

assertions.text: Screenshots exist for 1440,1280,768,390,360 and a 1280x720 125 % projector run
Rapid A/B/C switching, slider extremes and dead-control checks were run
QA.md contains a release verdict and evidence paths

evals.prompt: Check the desiccant section works at all regeneration temperatures.
evals.expected_output: Sweep at 40/50/60/70 C x ambient/exhaust air, verdict table, not-beneficial sentence appears exactly when net <= 0, status wording intact, cross-check with desiccantSweep.

assertions.text: All 8 combinations recorded with their verdict
'Desikan tidak menguntungkan pada kondisi ini.' appears exactly when the net is not positive
Status 'Hipotesis riset · belum divalidasi' present in every state

evals.prompt: Test the presentation mode and exports.
evals.expected_output: ?presentasi=1 keyboard path (arrows, 1-8, R, L), skenario presets, /export?static=1 figures at DSF 3 with footers, no console errors.

assertions.text: Keys ←/→, 1–8, R and L were exercised with observable results
Every [data-export] figure was captured and checked for footer and NaN

evals.prompt: Does the 3 rainy days scenario keep the hotel running and not lie?
evals.expected_output: Toggles 24 h / 3 hari hujan, checks SoC decay, backup takeover, unmet = 0, no zero-sun, net may be worse than B1 stated.

assertions.text: Unmet demand is 0 across all 72 h
Reports the net CO2e statement and whether it admits it can be worse than B1

evals.prompt: Does the mobile stage still let me scroll the page when I swipe over the 3D model?
evals.expected_output: Touch-context Playwright test with vertical swipe, measured scrollY change, evidence.

assertions.text: Uses a hasTouch context and reports scrollY before/after the swipe
